Risk Statement
LxC is the likelihood and consequence rating. The information above was last approved by the Human System Risk Board (HSRB) under the previous 3x4 LxC matrix. The HSRB has now migrated to a new 5x5 LxC matrix as defined in the new Risk Management Plan which may change the risk rating once brought forward for approval. This risk is scheduled to be updated at the 2025 HSRB.

Given crew is exposed to radiation from the space environment, there is the possibility for increased cancer morbidity or mortality.
